unit_title: Political Structure of the Roman Empire

questions.stem: Who was the highest authority in the Roman Empire?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! The Emperor was the highest authority during the Roman Empire.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. During the Roman Empire, the highest authority was the Emperor.

questions.stem: The Roman Empire used a democratic system of governance.
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! The Roman Empire was governed by an autocratic system, not a democracy.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. The Roman Empire was not democratic, it was governed by an autocratic system.

questions.stem: The ___, a group of elected officials, served as advisors to the Emperor in the Roman Empire.
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! The Senate served as advisors to the Emperor in the Roman Empire.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. In the Roman Empire, the group of elected officials that served as advisors to the Emperor was the Senate.

questions.stem: What political body held the most legislative power during the Roman Empire?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Although the Senate had legislative roles, the most legislative power was held by the Emperor during the Roman Empire.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. During the Roman Empire, the most legislative power was held by the Emperor, not the Senate.
